brief.headline: SK Hynix brakes HBM4 ramp to harvest DDR5 90% OPM; Samsung announces 90T won buyback after 12% flush
brief.summary: <cite index="36-1,36-2,36-8">SK Hynix briefly overtook Samsung's 26-year KOSPI market cap lead on June 22 before both names crashed 12% the next day, restoring Samsung's rank</cite>. <cite index="42-8">Samsung announced a 90 trillion won share buyback today, driving a 10% rally</cite>. <cite index="8-4,8-8,36-12,36-13">SK Hynix is delaying HBM4 line conversions to capture commodity DRAM margin that now approaches 90%, after DDR5 contract prices surged 90-95% QoQ in Q1 2026</cite>. <cite index="10-7,13-15">DRAM contract prices forecast to climb 58-63% QoQ in Q2, NAND Flash 70-75% QoQ</cite>. <cite index="21-2,21-6">Hyperscaler capex climbed from $400B in 2025 to $700B in 2026</cite>.
brief.pair_trade_view: Tactical long Samsung on 90T won buyback vs. SK Hynix: Samsung reclaimed 340K won after the buyback catalyst and holds lower 2026 HBM valuation multiples despite its share gain trajectory in 12-high HBM3E. SK Hynix slowing HBM4 to harvest DDR5 signals near-term prioritization of cash generation over accelerator-tied growth, validating concerns that HBM4 pull-in from Nvidia Rubin is softer than consensus. Samsung foundry integration remains a 2027 call option for HBM cost structure vs. SK Hynix's TSMC packaging dependency. Watch for Samsung HBM qualification wins at AMD/Broadcom to narrow the 30% pricing discount cited by sell-side.

memory_cycle.notes: DDR5 operating margin approaching 90% (vs. HBM3E 40-50% range) has inverted conventional HBM > DRAM margin hierarchy and triggered wafer-start reallocation. Q1 DRAM +90-95% QoQ, Q2 +58-63%, supply constrained through mid-2027. NAND accelerating faster than DRAM for first time this cycle (+70-75% Q2 vs. DRAM +58-63%) as enterprise SSD absorbs capacity. Hyperscalers locking multi-year LTAs; spot markets illiquid. Micron fulfilling only 55-60% of core demand. New fab capacity (Micron Idaho, SK Hynix M15X) not operational until 2027+. Risk: cycle peak signaled by margin-driven capacity reallocation away from flagship AI products.

brief.hbm_pulse: <cite index="2-1,4-1,4-14">HBM3E spot pricing $300/36GB stack (~$13-17/GB), down from H1 2025 peak of $17-20/GB</cite>. <cite index="1-3,6-15">SK Hynix holds 50-57% HBM share, Samsung 35-40%</cite>. <cite index="4-3,4-16">Samsung discounting ~30% below SK Hynix to win design slots</cite>. <cite index="3-12,5-10">HBM3E remains supply-constrained as Samsung/SK Hynix prioritize HBM4 ramp, though SK Hynix now delaying that transition</cite>. <cite index="6-11,6-13">HBM3E expected to account for ~67% of 2026 HBM shipments as HBM4 gradually increases share; major tech firms (Google TPU, Amazon Trainium) selecting HBM3E for 2026 launches</cite>. <cite index="2-12,2-13">Lead times remain 20-26 weeks; supply constrained through 2026</cite>. <cite index="8-10,8-17">Rubin HBM4 production forecasts trending down; SK Hynix slowing HBM4 actually supports HBM pricing by restraining future supply</cite>. Goldman expects HBM3E to decline 28% YoY in 2026 under competitive pressure.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix overtakes Samsung for first time in 26 years, then both crash 12% next day
news_pulse.implication: Historic milestone exposes structural shift in Korea semis: AI-driven HBM bet paid off for SK Hynix but valuations stretched. June 23 flush triggered KOSPI circuit breakers twice; volatility reflects positioning unwind ahead of Micron earnings as 'AI demand litmus test'.

news_pulse.headline: Samsung announces 90 trillion won share buyback after 12% decline
news_pulse.implication: Epic bullish catalyst drives Samsung +10% recovery to 340,500 won; forced short covering stabilizes broader KOSPI (+3.26%). Signals management urgency to defend valuation after losing market cap crown and lagging SK Hynix YTD (+340% vs Samsung +193%).

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix slows HBM4 ramp to harvest 90% DDR5 operating margins
news_pulse.implication: Resource allocation shift confirms commodity DRAM now more profitable than accelerating into next HBM gen. Easing HBM4 pace supports HBM pricing by restraining future supply but raises concerns about Rubin demand trajectory. Front-end wafers fungible; packaging TSV step is constraint.

news_pulse.headline: SK Hynix plans $29.65B Nasdaq ADR listing as soon as July 10
news_pulse.implication: 45.45T won capital raise to fund Yongin Cluster (2027+) and $4B Indiana packaging plant. Timing leverages peak HBM narrative; broadens US investor base ahead of potential cycle downturn. BofA, Citi, Goldman, JPM managing.

news_pulse.headline: DRAM Q2 contract prices to surge 58-63% QoQ; NAND 70-75% QoQ (TrendForce)
news_pulse.implication: NAND now outpacing DRAM for first time this cycle as enterprise SSD demand absorbs capacity. Server DRAM +60% QoQ; client SSD +40% QoQ despite weak PC demand. Hyperscalers securing multi-year LTAs; meaningful capacity expansion not until late 2027.

news_pulse.headline: Hyperscaler 2026 capex tops $700B, up 75% YoY; 2027 estimate exceeds $1T
news_pulse.implication: Meta raised FY26 guide to $125-145B (up $10B), Microsoft +24% to $190B, Alphabet +4% to $185B, Amazon +1% to $200B. 75% allocated to AI infra (GPUs, HBM servers, networking). Sustains memory demand through 2026 but financing risk rising (Oracle CDS tripled).

news_pulse.headline: TSMC CoWoS capacity reaches 120-130K wpm by end-2026, up 10x from 2023
news_pulse.implication: Nvidia secured ~60% of 2026 CoWoS capacity; Broadcom 15%, AMD 11%. Packaging no longer bottleneck for HBM integration but remains strategic lock-in for TSMC. CoPoS panel-level pilot line established; mass production 2028+.

news_pulse.headline: HBM3E pricing expected to decline 28% YoY in 2026 from $15/GB to $10/GB (Goldman)
news_pulse.implication: Competitive pressure from Samsung/Micron ramp offsets demand growth. HBM4 premium (~40% above HBM3E) and shipment growth will partially offset ASP decline. Samsung cutting HBM3E 5% below SK Hynix; may cut further to regain share.

brief.derivatives_signal: KOSPI June 23 circuit-breaker trigger and 12% single-day drop in both Samsung/SK Hynix signals elevated volatility regime; implied vol likely spiked. Samsung 90T won buyback announcement drove V-shaped recovery (+10% June 24) but technical damage done. Watch KOSPI 200 futures for follow-through; if June 24 rally fades, signals distribution. ADR premiums (SSNLF, HXSCL OTC) likely dislocated during Asia session flush—arb opportunity if Seoul stabilizes. Memory complex de-rated globally on SK Hynix HBM4 slowdown narrative; Micron earnings tonight is binary for sector sentiment reset.
watch_for_next_3h: Micron (MU) FY Q3 earnings tonight—guidance on HBM4 ramp, DRAM bit supply, and 2027 capex will set tone for memory complex and validate/refute SK Hynix slowdown narrative
Samsung buyback execution details (timeline, price range, whether it includes preferred shares); follow-through in Seoul session June 25
Any Nvidia/AMD commentary on Rubin/MI400 HBM4 pull-in timing following reports of downward production forecasts
SK Hynix ADR roadshow messaging and pricing for July 10 Nasdaq listing; investor reception to $29.65B raise at cycle peak
